decision: How to get urgent claims to the front of the queue

options.name: Do nothing
options.cost_running: about 250k a year in handler time and complaints

options.name: Sort by a written checklist
options.description: Give handlers a checklist and a shared sheet.

options.name: Configure the existing claims system
options.description: Add triage rules to the system we already run.
options.benefit: Rules the business can change; one system

recommendation.reason: It meets the need at about half the cost of a new product and keeps claims in one system
recommendation.biggest_risk: The vendor release that carries the rule table slips
recommendation.mitigation: Agree the release date in writing before we commit

unknowns: Whether the claims system can take a band from the web form (a two-week test will show)
